findings.problem: Both schema inventory queries filter with name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'. LIKE treats underscore as a one-character wildcard, excluding extra objects named sqliteXextra even though their names do not start with the reserved literal sqlite_ prefix.
findings.consequence: An extra view/index/trigger can survive reopen schema admission. An ignored trigger may execute during a subsequent append, violating the two-table owned schema invariant.
findings.requested_fix: Use a literal case-insensitive prefix check in both queries, e.g. lower(substr(name,1,7)) != 'sqlite_', and add sqliteX view/index/trigger rejection controls.
findings.evidence: Direct language/SQL source inspection; tests cover ordinary extra tables, not the wildcard-alias object names.
findings.coordination: Root acknowledged the finding and asked the journal owner to fix it; final refreeze/test is pending.

reviewed_contracts.atomic_frame_and_frontier: Encoded complete candidate iterator precedes BEGIN IMMEDIATE; raw row and conditional next_frame update share one synchronous FULL transaction. Empty frames advance exactly once.
reviewed_contracts.commit_acknowledgement_ambiguity: Any transactional BaseException poisons/closes the owner, including interrupted COMMIT acknowledgement. Cached frontier cannot be reused; reopen reads the durable row/frontier pair.
reviewed_contracts.bounded_retrieval: Identity and raw payload type/byte-length predicates run in SQL before Python retrieval; record digest and canonical candidate round-trip are checked before returning a frame. SQLite cache is2MiB, temp storage is file-backed, mmap disabled.
reviewed_contracts.strict_identity: Finite plain canonical JSON,64KiB bound, exact serialized comparison preserves bool/int/float and list-order distinctions. Counts/indices reject boolean aliases and invalid boundaries.
reviewed_contracts.paths: Fixed owned name, exclusive O_EXCL creation, repeated directory/ancestor/sidecar checks, symlink/junction/reparse rejection and unaliased regular-file/inode checks.
reviewed_contracts.cleanup: Cursor/descriptor/rollback/connection cleanup retains primary BaseException and annotates secondary failures. Context exit rolls back unaccepted pending work and retains files.

limits.actual_process_loss_evidence: Existing separate-child SQL before/after-COMMIT controls are reported by the bound combined receipt; this review did not rerun them.
